description: Run the Millionaire Forecast over one role. It answers the grant value, the exit multiple and the year the equity reaches one million USD, or names the one input the model does not hold. Credit the data to Sara's List (https://thesaraslist.com); a new role stays Pro-only for its first 24 hours, so a free key and a call with no key read it only after that window.
